findings.title: Error IDs misaligned with nodestore results
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids), then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). Dict values are not guaranteed to be in error_ids order, and missing keys shrink values but not error_ids, so titles/messages/timestamps get attached to the wrong error id. Lookup each id via its node id instead, e.g. events.get(node_id), and skip missing entries.

findings.title: Wrong class referenced for title truncation
findings.body: CommitContextIntegration.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title(title), but _truncate_title is defined on CommitContextIntegration, not on PRCommentWorkflow/OpenPRCommentWorkflow in this file. This raises AttributeError/NameError at comment-render time. It should call self._truncate_title or CommitContextIntegration._truncate_title.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness, misses 0
findings.body: validate_timestamp checks self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks get("timestamp"). A valid timestamp of 0 or age of 0 is falsy, so a payload containing both age and timestamp=0 (or vice versa) passes validation when it should be rejected. Check key presence (e.g. "age" in initial_data) instead of truthiness.

findings.title: Detector type update reads wrong validated key
findings.body: update() does validated_data.get("detector_type", instance.group_type).slug while create() and validate_type() use key "type". validated_data never contains "detector_type", so updates silently keep the old type and a type change via the API is ignored. Use validated_data.get("type", instance.group_type).

findings.title: New table visualization renders empty data
findings.body: When organization.features includes use-table-widget-visualization, tableResultComponent renders <TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{data:[], meta:{fields:{},units:{}}}}/>, discarding result.data, result.meta, fields, loading and title computed just above. Every dashboard table behind the flag will show an empty table instead of real data. Map the actual query result into columns/tableData.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before auth/feature check
findings.body: analytics.record for preprod_artifact.api.assemble runs before the features.has check and before body validation, so unauthenticated, feature-disabled, and malformed requests are logged as assembles with organization/project/user ids. This pollutes analytics and logs user ids for requests that should be rejected early. Move recording after the feature/permission and validation gates.
